verification.validation: Focused release gate for a frontend-only change: docs, version, protocol/native-contract limits and executor manifest checks on macOS; frontend gate (scripts/ts-gate.sh) in a Linux container: typecheck, 1442 units, build, packed consumer import, pack contents and internal-content package scan; Go api app.status/language units. Both npm tarballs packed in a Linux container (the Node package from its committed dist, whose only change is the version) and scanned for internal content (generic rules; no private denylist set). No full gate, QEMU, executor rebuild, Rust build, crate publication or NAS acceptance.

changes: bootEntryPage sends the DSM display-language hint for a sign-in already in the entry cache: the cached screen mounts at once, the DSM read and the hinted app.status run in the background, and a different language updates the cache and reloads the page once into it (once per language in a tab, not after user input; the reload option overrides it). An unreadable language or a failed status keeps the cached language. Before, a cached sign-in kept the language of a cache written before 0.53.47 or before the user changed DSM's display language (from #230).
Reuse executor 0.53.6 unchanged: executor sources and build inputs are unchanged.
